passages.text: Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took it into Abinadab’s house on the hill. And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The men of Kiriath-jearim came.
They took the ark of the LORD.
They brought the ark into the house of Abinadab.
Abinadab’s house was on the hill.
They set apart Eleazar, Abinadab’s son.
They made Eleazar holy for a special task.
Eleazar guarded the ark of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י׀ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֗ים וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֤ר בְּנוֹ֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּ לִשְׁמֹ֖ר אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim. And all the house of Israel mourned and sought after the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The ark of the LORD stayed in Kiriath-jearim.
It remained there for twenty years.
A long time passed while the ark was there.
All the people of Israel mourned.
They longed for the LORD.
They sought after Him.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִיּ֞וֹם שֶׁ֤בֶת הָֽאָרוֹן֙ בְּקִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיִּנָּה֛וּ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader in Israel.
Samuel spoke to all the people of Israel.
Samuel said, “If you return to the LORD with all your heart, you must do something.
Remove the foreign gods from among you.
Remove the Ashtoreths from among you.
Prepare your hearts for the LORD.
Serve the LORD only.
If you do this, the LORD will save you from the Philistines.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֶל־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־ בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם שָׁבִים֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה הָסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֧י הַנֵּכָ֛ר מִתּוֹכְכֶ֖ם וְהָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְהָכִ֨ינוּ לְבַבְכֶ֤ם אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וְעִבְדֻ֣הוּ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְיַצֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites acted together.
They removed the Baals from among them.
They also removed the Ashtoreths from among them.
They served the LORD alone.
passages.original: וַיָּסִ֙ירוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעַשְׁתָּרֹ֑ת וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader of Israel.
Samuel spoke to the people of Israel.
Samuel said, “Gather all Israel at Mizpah.”
Samuel said, “I will pray to the LORD for you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל קִבְצ֥וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּ֥ל בַּעַדְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted, and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gathered at Mizpah.
They drew water.
They poured the water out before the LORD.
They fasted on that day.
They said, “We have sinned against the LORD.”
Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ הַ֠מִּצְפָּתָה וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֜יִם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכ֣וּ׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּצ֙וּמוּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ שָׁ֔ם חָטָ֖אנוּ לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֧ט שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, their rulers marched up toward Israel. And when the Israelites learned of this, they feared the Philistines and said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.”
passages.sermon:
The Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah.
The Philistines had rulers.
These rulers marched up toward Israel.
The Israelites learned that the Philistines were coming.
The Israelites became afraid of the Philistines.
The Israelites spoke to Samuel.
Samuel was a prophet and leader of Israel.
The Israelites said, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us.”
They wanted Samuel to pray to God for them.
They said, “Ask God to save us from the hand of the Philistines.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּֽי־ הִתְקַבְּצ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַמִּצְפָּ֔תָה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ סַרְנֵֽי־ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּֽרְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃ וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל אַל־ תַּחֲרֵ֣שׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מִזְּעֹ֖ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵ֖נוּ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on behalf of Israel, and the LORD answered him.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and judge of Israel.
Samuel took a young lamb.
The lamb was still nursing.
Samuel offered the lamb as a whole burnt offering.
He gave the offering to the LORD.
Samuel cried out to the LORD for Israel.
The LORD answered Samuel.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל טְלֵ֤ה חָלָב֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַיַּעֲלֶה עוֹלָ֛ה כָּלִ֖יל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּזְעַ֨ק שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בְּעַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: As the Philistines drew near to fight against Israel, Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering. But that day the LORD thundered loudly against the Philistines and threw them into such confusion that they fled before Israel.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was offering a burnt sacrifice to the LORD.
The Philistines came close to fight against Israel.
The LORD thundered with a loud voice against the Philistines that day.
The LORD confused the Philistines.
The Philistines fled before Israel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י שְׁמוּאֵל֙ מַעֲלֶ֣ה הָעוֹלָ֔ה וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים נִגְּשׁ֔וּ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּרְעֵ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה׀ בְּקוֹל־ גָּ֠דוֹל בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֤וּא עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ וַיְהֻמֵּ֔ם וַיִּנָּגְפ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel were at Mizpah.
The men of Israel left Mizpah.
They chased the Philistines.
They struck down the Philistines.
They defeated them all the way to a place below Beth-car.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִן־ הַמִּצְפָּ֔ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּכּ֕וּם עַד־ מִתַּ֖חַת לְבֵ֥ית כָּֽר׃

passages.text: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and judge over Israel.
Samuel took a stone.
He set the stone between Mizpah and Shen.
He named the stone Ebenezer.
Ebenezer means “stone of help.”
Samuel said, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶ֣בֶן אַחַ֗ת וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֵּֽין־ הַמִּצְפָּה֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַשֵּׁ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמָ֖הּ אֶ֣בֶן הָעָ֑זֶר וַיֹּאמַ֕ר עַד־ הֵ֖נָּה עֲזָרָ֥נוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped invading the territory of Israel. And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines were enemies of Israel.
God helped Israel defeat the Philistines.
The Philistines became weak.
They did not enter Israel’s land again.
God’s power was against the Philistines.
God opposed the Philistines during all the days of Samuel.
Samuel was Israel’s leader at that time.
passages.original: וַיִּכָּֽנְעוּ֙ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְלֹא־ יָסְפ֣וּ ע֔וֹד לָב֖וֹא בִּגְב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתְּהִ֤י יַד־ יְהוָה֙ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The cities from Ekron to Gath, which the Philistines had taken, were restored to Israel, who also delivered the surrounding territory from the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between the Israelites and the Amorites.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines had taken cities from Israel.
These cities were between Ekron and Gath.
Israel got these cities back.
Israel also rescued the surrounding territory from the Philistines.
There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
passages.original: וַתָּשֹׁ֣בְנָה הֶעָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָֽקְחוּ־ פְלִשְׁתִּים֩ מֵאֵ֨ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵעֶקְר֣וֹן וְעַד־ גַּ֔ת וְאֶ֨ת־ גְּבוּלָ֔ן הִצִּ֥יל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם בֵּ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבֵ֥ין הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃

passages.text: So Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
passages.sermon: Samuel was a judge in Israel.\r\nHe judged Israel for his entire life.\r\nHe led the people as judge every day until he died.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Every year he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all these places.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a judge over Israel.
He traveled every year.
He went from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah.
He visited these places in a circuit.
He judged Israel in each of these places.
passages.original: וְהָלַ֗ךְ מִדֵּ֤י שָׁנָה֙ בְּשָׁנָ֔ה וְסָבַב֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וְהַגִּלְגָּ֖ל וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וְשָׁפַט֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמְּקוֹמ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there, and there he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a judge over Israel.
Samuel lived in Ramah.
Samuel returned to Ramah after traveling.
Samuel’s home was in Ramah.
Samuel judged Israel in Ramah.
Samuel built an altar to the LORD in Ramah.
passages.original: וּתְשֻׁבָת֤וֹ הָרָמָ֙תָה֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁ֣ם בֵּית֔וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם שָׁפָ֣ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽבֶן־ שָׁ֥ם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
